description: Summary of the managed GDEX wallet on one chain: managed address, native balance (approximate, /v1/user), token count and USD total (/v1/portfolio). Needs the session (accountRef); there is no address-only read.

accountRef.description: Connected account from gdex_connect. Supplies session key, wallet address, API key and session data so no secret is passed in chat

data.description: Encrypted session data, instead of sessionPrivateKey + apiKey

sessionPrivateKey.description: Session private key from sign-in (with apiKey)

walletAddress.description: Control wallet address (the GDEX userId), not the managed trading wallet

name: get_wallet_info
